_comment: Montgomery County CXR Set (NLM tuberculosis screening). Only the required keys and expected_stats are written here. The other config fields are not written yet.

expected_stats._comment: Checked by tests/test_dataset_stats.py. Sources (2026-11-03): NLM-MontgomeryCXRSet-ReadMe.pdf (138 images: 58 TB, 80 normal), and the raw files read with Python: the CXR_png/ file names and the ClinicalReadings/*.txt files. The file name suffix _1 is TB. Each file name is one study. 3 readings say 'same pt as' another image (MCUCXR_0117_1 names MCUCXR_0113_1, MCUCXR_0166_1 and MCUCXR_0170_1 name MCUCXR_0162_1), so 138 images give 135 patients. The ReadMe gives no patient count. 'Patient's Sex' is F (74), M (63) or O (1, MCUCXR_0080_0), and O gives NaN (D-26). 'Patient's Age' is in years, for example 027Y. 137 readings have a report: MCUCXR_0166_1 only says 'NO REPORT (same pt as MCUCXR_0162_1)', which counts as no report (D-33). rows_with_mask is not written: ManualMask/ has a left and a right mask for all 138 images, but the table gets a mask_path column only when harmonize() gets mask_output_dir.
